name: Switch Target
text: Trigger The creature you've currently Aimed at gains the Dying or Unconscious condition. Requirements You're wielding a gun. As your target falls, you immediately home in on the next. You Aim at a different creature.

text:
Trigger The creature you've currently Aimed at gains the or condition.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

As your target falls, you immediately home in on the next. You Aim at a different creature.

name: Swoltrid
text: Inspired by the anatomy of other species in the Pact Worlds, you've augmented yourself with humanoid arms, whether cybernetic or biotech, that would put even world-class bodybuilders to shame. You gain a second pair of arms. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can take the Switch Hands action to change your active hands. Add the All Hands on Deck and Double Draw ancestry feats to your list of standardized ancestry feats.

name: Swooping Rescue
text: Requirements You have at least one hand free. You swoop down, use your strong cilia to grab your friend, and fly them off to safety. Fly twice. At any point during this movement, you can [[/act grapple]] one willing ally within reach. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check to Grapple your ally if you have two free hands or they have a free hand and are aware of you. The Grabbed condition ends once you have completed your movement.

name: Symbiotic Summon
text: You can instantly merge with a creature you summon. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that summons a minion, you merge with the minion instead of summoning them. This works like animal form, except your form's Size, Speeds, AC, senses, attacks, and Athletics modifiers are identical to the summoned creature (you don't gain temporary Hit Points). If you're reduced to 0 Hit Points while merged with your summoned minion, the effect ends, and you return to your normal self with half as many Hit Points as you originally had when you first merged with your summoned minion.

name: Sympathetic Bond
text: Dragonkin have the ability to form permanent bonds with a chosen partner. Some ryphorians, through countless years of close proximity to the draconic inhabitants of Triaxus, have learned to emulate this ability to a limited degree. You can form a temporary bond with one willing sapient creature as a 10-minute activity that can only be attempted if you and your partner share a deep bond. Once formed, this bond lasts for 1 day. When you're within 30 feet of this bonded creature, you both gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves.

name: Sync Up
text: Frequency once per day You've learned to hone your psychic abilities to create a bespoke hive mind. You let out a psychic battle cry that links yourself and up to 10 allies within range of your limited telepathy into a temporary hive mind for 3 rounds, allowing them to communicate telepathically with everyone else in the hive mind. You and the allies in your hive mind become Quickened for 3 rounds and can use the extra action only to Step, Stride, or prepare to Aid. For the duration, you and all allies in your hive mind can't be flanked. If an ally in your hive mind uses a ranged Strike against a target being flanked by two other allies in your hive mind, that target is Off-Guard to that Strike. Allies who leave the range of your limited telepathy lose all benefits of being in your hive mind as long as they remain outside of your limited telepathy.

name: Synchronized Action
text: Your ability to ride your bonded partner into battle has further improved, and you act as one body and one mind. When you ride your bonded partner as a mount, you gain three actions at the start of your turn, rather than the two you normally would.

name: Synchronized Advance
text: Two actions: with a drone you Synchronized Step; with a turret you Stride and Reposition Exocortex. If you end this movement adjacent to your drone or turret, you make a ranged Strike and then Take Cover behind it.

name: Synchronized Initiative
text: Trigger You and your bonded partner roll the same skill for initiative, but get different results. You and your bonded partner act in utter synchronicity with one another, reacting to danger and entering battle as one. You and your bonded partner use the higher result between your initiative rolls, but use the lower Perception or skill modifier.

name: Syncretic Epiphany
text: Plumbing the depths of your own connection, you understand how your piece of reality interconnects with another. You learn the advanced epiphany spell of the connection that grants training in the prerequisite connection skill.

name: Syncretic Epiphany
text: Plumbing the depths of your own connection, you understand how your piece of reality interconnects with another. You learn the advanced epiphany spell of the connection that grants training in the prerequisite connection skill.

name: Synergistic Assistance
text: 1 to 3 Brenneris often live and work in pairs to take advantage of different areas of expertise, inspired by the old adage that says two heads are always better than one. You stick close to your companions so you can help one another in a jam. You gain an extra reaction at the start of each of your turns that can only be used to Aid.

name: Synthesize Vapor
text: Frequency once per hour You create a cloud of vapor around yourself. This vapor lasts for 1 minute or until you move. You become Concealed within the mist, and other creatures outside the mist become concealed to you.

name: Synthesized Black Hole
text: Frequency once per day Your core pierces into the void and creates a black hole that tears apart the souls of everyone around you. All creatures within a take |options:area-damage] damage with a basic fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails this save is also pulled 5 feet toward you (or pulled 10 feet toward you and knocked Prone on a critical failure). For 1 minute, any creature that ends its turn within a around you takes |options:area-damage] damage (basic Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC). If you aren't glitching, you can choose to become glitching 1 when you use Synthesized Black Hole to increase the radius of the emanation from 10 feet to 30 feet. You can't reduce your glitching value for as long as Synthesized Black Hole is in effect, but you can Dismiss the effect.

name: Synthetic Physiology
text:
Your unusual synthetic physiology enables you to resist aliments even better than most constructed or biological organisms. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease, poison, or radiation, you get a critical success instead.

If you roll a critical failure on the save, you get a failure instead.

name: Synthetic Speech
text: You can cast speak with computers once per day as a 4th rank arcane innate spell.

name: System Overload
text: You generate an overwhelming surge of electricity from within your body, engulfing yourself in a storm of sparks that causes nearby tech to malfunction. You can cast Overload Systems as a 7th-rank arcane innate spell once per hour. Raxilites and raxilite technology are immune to this spell, and you can choose up to four squares to exclude from the area of the spell.

name: Tactical Advance
text: Requirements You aren't Encumbered. You dodge, roll, and weave out of danger, leaving no openings for attack as you move across the battlefield. Stride up to your Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

name: Tactical Bond
text: You and your bonded partner have learned to physically shield one another from harm. If you would grant lesser cover to your bonded partner (including when your partner is using you as a mount), or your bonded partner would grant lesser cover to you, standard cover is granted instead.

name: Tactical Bully
text: Requirements Your last action was a successful Shove. You use your size and strength to push and position your enemies around the battlefield. You attempt to Trip the creature you successfully Shoved, even if the target is no longer in your reach. If you have a tail attack, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Trip attempt.

name: Tactical Customization
text: Your drone gains one tactical customization, granting it a new ability. Special: you can select this feat up to three times.

name: Tactical Drone
text: Your drone becomes a mature companion. During an encounter, even if you don't Command it, it can use 1 action that round on your turn to Stride or Strike (if it does, that's all the actions it gets that round).

name: Tactical Flicker
text: You've trained to use your reality issues to your advantage in a fight. When you use Flickering Existence, you can make one Strike before or after the movement.

name: Tactical Swap
text: Frequency once per round Requirements Your last ranged Strike this turn missed or hit and failed to damage the target. You swap weapons with a practiced motion. You Switch Hands or Interact to swap your current weapon for another. Make a Strike against the required target with your newly drawn weapon.

You swap weapons with a practiced motion. You Switch Hands or Interact to swap your current weapon for another. Make a Strike against the required target with your newly drawn weapon.

name: Tactical Team-Up
text: Two actions: your turret makes a ranged Strike against a creature in its first range increment, then you make a ranged Strike against the same target; the target is off-guard against your Strike.

name: Tag Team
text:
Trigger The target of your is critically hit by an ally's attack or critically fails a Reflex save against an ally's attack or spell.

You seize the opening your ally has provided, quickly attacking your foe. Make a Strike against the triggering creature. If it's a ranged Strike, it must be in your weapon's first range increment. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

name: Tag Team (Starfinder)
text: Trigger The target of your Get 'Em! is critically hit by an ally's attack or critically fails a Reflex save against an ally's attack or spell. You seize the opening your ally has provided, quickly attacking your foe. Make a Strike against the triggering creature. If it's a ranged Strike, it must be in your weapon's first range increment. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

name: Tail Glide
text: You can use your fluffy tail to guide your descent when falling through the air. You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action Tail Gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

name: Take 'Em Alive!
text: You urge your allies to take down your enemies without incurring any loss of life. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies can add the nonlethal trait to your attacks with weapons (without taking the normal penalty), and to your spells that deal damage and don't have the death or void trait. Lead by Example If you used two actions, Strike a target with a nonlethal attack. On a success, you gain a status bonus to damage equal to your Charisma modifier. On a critical success, an ally within 30 feet can Strike the target as a reaction using a nonlethal attack.

name: Take Me Seriously
text: Trigger You fail at an attempt to [[/act demoralize]] a creature. You bare your teeth in aggression at your target. It loses temporary immunity to your attempts to Demoralize it until the end of your next turn, and its attitude toward you decreases by one step. The creature then becomes immune to Take Me Seriously for 24 hours.

name: Take the Wheel
text: You Board and Take Control of an adjacent vehicle.

name: Tale Spinner
text: You keep your people's stories alive with magic. You can cast Figment and Prestidigitation as occult innate spells at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

name: Talented Tracker
text: Your keen nose makes you an excellent tracker. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background of class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Track . This bonus increases to +2 when tracking by scent. You also gain the Experienced Tracker skill feat.

name: Talon Transporter
text: You've learned to carry additional supplies using your talons. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat. If you already have this feat, instead increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limits by 2. While floating or flying you may use your feet as an additional pair of hands, but only to carry up to 4 Bulk of creatures or items beyond your maximum encumbrance.

name: Tashtari Cluster
text: You can have two pieces of overclocked gear at once, and you choose which gear is no longer overclocked the next time you use Jailbreak Spell.

name: Teachings of the Forgefather
text: You have learned magic common among questbound dwarves that focuses on Torag's lessons and the New Quest for Sky. You gain the ancestry feats (divine; ) and (divine; ).

name: Tech Caster
text: Your ability to control and empower technological devices has improved. You gain Delete and Supercharge Weapon as 1st-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each of these divine innate spells once per day.

name: Tech Crafting
text: You can Craft level 1 or higher tech items, though some have other requirements. When you select this feat, you gain formulas for four common tech items of 2nd level or lower.

name: Tech Familiarity
text: You have an intuitive understanding of computers, machines, and other technological devices. You become trained in Computers and Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

name: Techentu
text: You can permanently merge with a willing or destroyed creature with the tech trait. If the creature is mindless, it gains awareness and can choose whether to accept the symbiosis (depending on the circumstances gauged by the GM or determined by a flat). If you succeed, you can no longer use Tactical Symbiosis, but you gain basic environmental protections, protection against extreme cold and extreme heat, and a +3 status bonus to saves against disease, poison, and radiation. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Disguise yourself as the creature you merged with, and you can communicate with your host's kin and other compatible models likely serving the same function or built by the same manufacturer, as though you'd cast Speak with Computers.

name: Technomagical Scrapper
text: Given how most humans don't have ancestral home worlds of their own, many must scrape and scavenge to get by. You become trained in Crafting and your choice of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. If you were already trained in Crafting, you become an expert instead. If you were already trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, and Religion, you become an expert in one of those skills instead. You can items that have both the magic and tech traits without a repair toolkit and without taking a −2 circumstance penalty, improvising tools from whatever you have at hand.

name: Technomancer Dedication
text: You weave technology and magic together. You gain access to two cantrips of your choice from the technomancer spell list and a spell repertoire of those cantrips. You're trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs using Intelligence as your spellcasting attribute. Special: You can't select another dedication feat until you've gained two other feats from the technomancer archetype. (Prerequisite Intelligence 14 shown for reference; not enforced in-app.)

name: Technomancer's Hack
text: You magically interface with a computer or technological device within 30 feet as though you had physically touched it. You can use your spell attack roll for computer checks made this way.

name: Technosymbiote
text: Requirements You're holding or adjacent to an unattended tech object. You have learned how to adapt your thought patterns to that of a tech device and can merge with a tech object to understand what it knows. This allows you to learn what the computer knows as if you spent an hour scanning the computer or engaging it in a conversation using speak with computers. You can [[/act hack]] the computer to access protected systems without needing a hacking toolkit and can Hack using Diplomacy or Nature instead of Computers. If the targeted object is an augmentation, you implant the augmentation.

name: Tectonic Psychic
text: Your psychic connection to the environment stretches to the ground below and manipulates lava as though it were alive. You gain Wall of Fire and Uncanny Eruption as 7th-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

name: Tectonic Tactician
text: You've learned how to fight enemies without leaving the safety of your tunnels. Your tremorsense provided by Tunnel Vision becomes a precise sense. While underground, you can target enemies you detect using tremorsense with Strikes, Area Fire, and Auto-Fire as long as the only material between you and the enemy is something you could normally move through using your burrow Speed. Unless you use adamantine ammunition, ranged attacks made through solid ground have their range increments halved, and you take a –2 circumstance penalty to your attack roll for ranged attacks that pass through the ground.

name: Telekinetic Titan
text: Straining every neuron, you briefly supercharge your telekinetic abilities. Choose Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom when you activate this ability. For 1 minute, you can carry Bulk equal to 7 + the chosen attribute modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk of 12 + the chosen attribute modifier. Your telekinetic hands can hold and wield objects heavier than 1 Bulk, and you ignore the effects of your atrophied ability. Finally, you gain the Telekinetic Lift action. When the duration ends, you become Fatigued for 1 minute, and your telekinetic hands drop any objects they can no longer hold.

name: Telepathic Conduit
text: Lashunta When you use limited telepathy to communicate with another creature, you act as a conduit for their thoughts, allowing them to respond to you for a few scant moments—if they wish. The creature can give you a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action at the beginning of their next turn as long as they remain within range of your telepathy. Shirren When you use limited telepathy to communicate with another creature, the creature can give you a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action at the beginning of their next turn.

name: Telepathic Onslaught
text: You unleash powerful telepathic feedback to assail the minds of your foes and render them unwell. Any number of enemy creatures you can sense within range of your limited telepathy take ] damage with a will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. You can choose for any of these creatures to take nonlethal instead of lethal damage from Telepathic Onslaught. On a failure, creatures are also Sickened 1 (or Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

name: Telepathic Reach
text: Your mental range extends beyond normal limits. Your telepathic communication range increases to 60 feet and you can communicate through up to 1 foot of stone.

name: Telepredict
text: You read the subtle cues of a target's brainwaves to anticipate the mental state of a single creature within range of your limited telepathy that you can detect with thoughtsense. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks and Intimidation checks targeting the creature, to saves against the target's effects that have the fear trait, and to your Will DC against the target's Intimidation skill actions, such as Demoralize. If you deal mental damage to the target, increase this bonus to +2. You can Telepredict the actions of only one creature at a time. Telepredict ends if you use it on a different creature or the creature leaves the range of your limited telepathy.

name: Temporal Glimpse
text: Your perception of time is more flexible than others. You can use your probability reroll ability twice per day instead of once.

name: Tenacious Flame
text: The flame from your Fire Breath now lingers on targets. When a target fails its save against your Fire Breath, it also takes 1d6 persistent fire damage. The damage increases to 2d6 at 13th level and 3d6 at 17th level. Special If you use Admixture Breath to change the damage type of your Fire Breath, the persistent damage changes to match the new damage type.

name: Tenacious Grip
text: Your hands maintain a firm grip on anything they hold. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to [[/act disarm]] you. A creature that succeeds at a check to Disarm you gains only a +1 circumstance bonus on further attempts to Disarm you, and you take only a –1 circumstance penalty to attacks with the held item.

name: Tentacle Whip
text: You grow a tentacle that can lash out like a whip. You gain a tentacle unarmed attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Your tentacle is in the brawling weapon group and has the barathu, finesse, reach, and unarmed traits.

name: Tenth Life
text: Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and would gain the dying condition or would otherwise die. You've discovered the fabled occult pahtra art of cheating death or have made substantial contingencies that help keep that legend alive. You prevent yourself from dying and regain Hit Points equal to ]{6d8 plus half your level}. If the cause of your death was a condition or effect that would still cause you to die after regaining Hit Points, such as a high value on the doomed condition, you suppress that condition for 1 minute.

name: Terraforming Mines
text: When you Deploy a mine, choose Big Bang (on detonation, push creatures 5 feet away; 10 feet + prone on a critical failure) or Gravity Field (the explosion's area becomes high, low, normal, or zero gravity for 1 minute).

name: Terrain Expertise
text: Your experience in a specific terrain type makes you more effective when navigating it. Choose one terrain type; you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks in that terrain.

name: Terrain Stalker
text: You move without a sound in your favored environment. Choose one terrain type; you can Sneak through that terrain without the usual movement penalty.

name: Terrified Retreat
text: When you critically succeed at the Demoralize action, if the target's level is lower than yours, the target is Fleeing for 1 round.

name: Terrifying Bravado
text: Trigger You critically succeed on a save against a fear effect whose source was a creature, or a creature fails or critically fails an Intimidation check to Demoralize you. You laugh at your enemy's failed attempts to bully you, turning the tables on your foe with a display of terrifying bravado. You attempt an Intimidation check to Demoralize the triggering creature.

name: Terrifying Negotiator
text: Trigger You roll Diplomacy or Intimidation for initiative. You know negotiations fail and aren't afraid to resort to force when they do. You attempt to [[/act demoralize]] a foe you were observing and engaged in conversation with for at least 1 minute.

name: Terror-Forming
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. Your weapon blasts apart the battlefield and leaves it a ruinous waste. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. You don't designate a primary target, but instead make each square in the area of your attack difficult terrain. If a square was already difficult terrain, it becomes greater difficult terrain. Any difficult or greater difficult terrain created by this action remains in place and can't be changed without extensive engineering or magic.

Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon.

Your weapon blasts apart the battlefield and leaves it a ruinous waste. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. You don't designate a primary target, but instead make each square in the area of your attack difficult terrain. If a square was already difficult terrain, it becomes greater difficult terrain. Any difficult or greater difficult terrain created by this action remains in place and can't be changed without extensive engineering or magic.

name: Tetrodotoxic Beak
text: Venomous glands near your mouth can give your saliva toxic properties. Your beak unarmed strike deals an additional 1 persistent poison damage. This increases to 2 persistent poison damage if your beak deals at least three weapon damage dice. In addition, you gain the Toxic Tear action.

name: That'll Show 'Em
text: When you warn an ally of an attack, you follow up with a shot at your enemy. The first time each round you use your Watch Out reaction, you can make a melee or ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If you hit, your target is Suppressed until the start of its next turn.

name: That'll Show 'Em
text: When you warn an ally of an attack, you follow up with a shot at your enemy. The first time each round you use your reaction, you can make a melee or ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike. If you hit, your target is until the start of its next turn.

name: The Ancestral Wellspring Overflows
text: Through study and meditation, you've found a powerful link to the great gifts your ancestors have prepared for you. Through your connection with the ancestral wellspring, you have access to the combined wisdom of thousands of generations. From their place between the stars, they can guide your actions and tell you things about the world around you that you'd never learn on your own. You are permanently Quickened and can use that extra action only to Recall Knowledge.

name: The Bigger They Are
text: You've learned to make good use of your diminutive stature and angle your attacks when fighting larger enemies. If you critically hit a Large or larger enemy with a ranged Strike while using a weapon that fires projectile ammo, you knock them . A creature knocked prone by your unusually angled shots learns how to brace for impact, becoming immune to The Bigger They Are for 24 hours.

name: The Gift of Glow
text: Frequency once per day Using readily available materials, you create pieces of art to inspire those who have inspired you. Choose an ally. You spend 1 hour to Craft a gift of negligible Bulk or larger with the consumable and primal traits, decorated with the talphis' signature glowing paint. As long as the chosen ally wears this gift, they can draw inspiration from it as an Interact action to gain a +1 status bonus to their next attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check until the start of their next turn and gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier + character level that last for 1 minute. The glow from your gift fades after 24 hours as it crumbles to dust. Special If you're legendary in Crafting, you can make up to five tokens per day, but each must be made for a different ally.

name: The Harder They Fall
text: Trigger A Large or larger creature within your melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies. You have become accustomed to dealing with creatures much larger than you, and you know very well how to use their size against them. The triggering creature must attempt a save against the higher of your class or spell DC. On a failure, the creature falls and takes ] damage equal to half your level.

name: The Hunter, Not The Hunted
text: Marata's fiercest predators are also some of its most cunning hunters, leaving little sign when attempting to remain unseen. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [[/act hide]] and [[/act sneak]] in natural terrain and a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Cover Tracks and [[/act track]] in natural terrain. You're always considered to be Covering Tracks, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode.

name: The Science of Motion
text: Your extensive scientific knowledge of astronomy, astrophysics, and stellar phenomenon have given you insight into the underpinnings of the universe—particularly motion. You can use this knowledge to more easily move your foes across the battlefield. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Reposition, Shove or Trip. If you critically fail an Athletics check to Reposition, Shove or Trip, you get a failure instead.

name: The Universal Language
text: You're well versed in using the subtle art of body language to convey the basics of your intentions, even when you don't share a language with whom you're attempting to communicate. You can use Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression]] without a shared language with your target. When you do, Make an Impression loses the auditory and linguistic traits, and you can attempt the Diplomacy check with a –2 circumstance penalty. When you do share at least one language with your target, you instead gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression.

name: Theory of Everything
text: Your fervently religious approach to acquiring information gives you insights and understanding into a broad array of subjects. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat. During your daily preparations, you can recontextualize your insights and change the chosen Lore skill for any of your Additional Lore skill feats, unless they're being used as a prerequisite for a permanent character option that your new Lore skill won't satisfy.

name: Thermal Conversion
text: Frequency once per hour Requirements You are in an area of severe, extreme, or incredible heat, or you were dealt fire damage within the last round. Your body has adapted to convert ambient thermal energy into kinetic energy to boost your speed. You Stride up to double your Speed. In addition, you become Quickened until the end of your next turn. You can only use the extra action from quickened to Stride.

name: Thick Hide
text: Your prehistoric armor thickens with age. Your natural armor bonus to AC increases by 1 and you gain resistance 2 to slashing and piercing damage.

name: Thick Skins
text: Each of your forms has unusually thick skin. Your DC on flat checks to end persistent bleed damage is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance. Special You can use the Restorative Shapeshifting feat to attempt an additional flat check to end persistent bleed damage, but this is not considered especially appropriate assistance.

name: Thief's Tale
text: You've trained your tail to move with incredible precision, practicing a specific set of underhanded skills until they become second nature. When you attempt to [[/act disable-device]] or [[/act pick-a-lock]], if you're holding no items other than tools to help you Disable a Device or Pick a Lock, you can spend an additional action to use your tail to help with the attempt. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your check to Disable a Device or Pick a Lock. On a success or critical success, you achieve an additional success if the device or lock requires more than one success.

name: This You, Queen?
text: The hottest socials on the infosphere might change with time, but the way those spaces fill up with drama and gossip is a truth that lasts forever. Luckily, you've been saving every embarrassing holo and compromising remark you've found on the infosphere to your personal archives for centuries. You can roll a Computers check instead of an Intimidation check when you use the [[/act coerce skill=computers]] action, threatening to share copies of an embarrassing infosphere moment from the target's past. On a success, in addition to the normal effects of Coerce, the target is temporarily immune to any additional Coerce attempts from you for 24 hours. On a failure, they're instead immune for 1 week, and on a critical failure, they're immune for 1 month.

name: Thornwall
text: You grow defensive thorns as a reaction. When a creature hits you with an unarmed or natural attack, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 piercing damage to the attacker.

name: Thorny
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes Your body is covered in thorns, spines, or other sharp protrusions, which you can position defensively. For 1 minute, adjacent creatures that hit you with a melee attack, as well as creatures that hit you with melee unarmed attacks, take ] damage equal to your level.

name: Thoroughly Slimed
text: Your sprayed slime thickens on contact with air, giving it some substantial stopping power and possibly even locking foes in place. When you use Slime Squirt or Slime Spray, creatures in the area must attempt a reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, they become Clumsy 1 for 1 round. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

text: You're capable of surviving in the void of space indefinitely. While you maintain suspended respiration, you are immune to inhaled threats. Additionally, as long as you use suspended respiration, you don't need to eat or drink. Once per day as a free action, you can suspend respiration in atmosphere with these benefits for 1 minute.

The first time each day that you roll Perception for initiative, you roll initiative twice and use the higher result.

If the undead creature currently is already in the thrall of a creature whose level is higher than yours, you typically need to roll a critical success (at GM discretion).

text: Your people's long history of clashing with Eox has made you wary. You become trained in Religion. If you were already trained in Religion, you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge about undead creatures.

name: Undead Senses
text: Your senses changed and improved after you died. Now you can feel the vitality energy radiating from living creatures and the void surrounding other undead entities like you. You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 10 feet, allowing you to pinpoint the locations of (and distinguish between) living and undead creatures, but not other unliving beings such as constructs.

name: Undead Slayer
text: You leverage your extensive knowledge of undead during combat. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage with weapons and unarmed attacks against undead creatures. If your attack would deal more than one weapon die of damage, the bonus is equal to the number of weapon dice or unarmed attack dice. Furthermore, when you succeed or critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge against an undead creature that you can see, you identify a weak spot in their defenses—for 1 minute, you gain access to the critical specialization effects of all weapons and unarmed attacks for attacks you make against that specific creature.

As long as you're Small, you can end a successful Tumble Through action in a Medium or larger enemy's space. The enemy must have appropriate limbs or otherwise leave you enough room for this maneuver, as determined by the GM. You couldn't, for example, occupy the space of an ooze that matches the full dimensions of the square. While you occupy an enemy's space, that enemy is Off-Guard to you.

name: Underwater Combatant

name: Underwater Marauder
text: You fight effectively in the water. You're not flat-footed in water, and you don't take the usual penalties for making bludgeoning or slashing attacks underwater.

name: Underwater Mastery
text: You've practiced with your magical pathways to increase the speed of your swimming, while learning to sense the currents of the waves around you. You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your swim Speed and gain wavesense out to 30 feet as an imprecise sense whenever you are underwater. If you are a master in Athletics, the status bonus to your swim Speed increases to a +10-foot bonus, and if you are legendary in Athletics, the status bonus to your swim Speed increases to a +15-foot bonus.

name: Undying Defiance

text: You use your experience and training as a manager to aggressively compel a foe within 30 feet into believing they've been fired. Roll a check against the target's Will DC. If you're a leader in the organization, you can roll a or check instead. The target must be a member of an organization (such a corporation, cult, gang, or military) or working on behalf of that organization. The head of an organization is immune to the effects of Unexpected Downsize. Critical Success The creature becomes unfriendly to all creatures from the same organization to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally for 1 minute. Success As success, but the effect ends after 1 round. Critical Failure The target knows you're bluffing and becomes immune to your Unexpected Downsize for 24 hours.

name: Unexpected Solution
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You're about to attempt a skill check or saving throw. Your reckless tactics surprise others when they occasionally work. You roll twice and take the better result. If you destroy a consumable item of half your level or higher in the process, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

name: Unfathomable Sorrow
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger An enemy causes you to become frightened or take persistent mental damage. The depth of your sorrow causes the negativity coming from others to cascade back at them. The triggering creature becomes Frightened 1, and that enemy can't reduce their frightened condition below 1 until the beginning of your next turn. Special The frequency of Unfathomable Sorrow is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to sorrow.

name: Unforgiving Fury
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger You critically succeed at a Strike. Violence further fuels your fury and resilience. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier until the end of your next turn. Special The frequency of Unforgiving Fury is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to fury.

name: Unhindered Advance
text: When you use Tactical Advance, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

name: Unhindered Advance
text: When you use , you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

name: Unified Theory
text: You understand the common underpinnings of the four traditions of magic and magical essences. Whenever you use a skill action or a skill feat that requires a Nature, Occultism, or Religion check, depending on the magic tradition, you can use Arcana instead. If you would normally take a penalty or have a higher DC for using Arcana on other magic (such as when using Identify Magic), you no longer do so.

name: Universal Diplomat
text: Your knack for reading people extends across cultural barriers. You can communicate simple ideas to any intelligent creature, even without a shared language, and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy with creatures of a different ancestry than your own.

name: Universal Telepath
text: Frequency once per day Communication via mere words is a limitation of lesser minds. Your thoughts weave meaning from words, feelings, mental imagery, and ineffable stimuli for 10 minutes, during which you can communicate using your limited telepathy without sharing a language. At 17th level, you can activate this feat at will.

name: Universal Translation
text: A lack of shared language can be a pernicious challenge for negotiations, interrogations, and diplomatic relations. As part of your ambassador corps training, you learned how to quickly establish linguistic connections with others. You can attempt a Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check with the linguistic trait that targets a creature that does not share a language with you. These attempts take a −4 circumstance penalty to the check. Furthermore, you can translate for your ambassador partner when they attempt any Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation check with the linguistic trait as a reaction with the auditory trait.

name: Universal Translator
text: By activating your arcane sensory organ and analyzing ancestral memories and arcane lore, you can communicate with all kinds of people, animals, and even plants. You gain Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C, Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qvwIwJ9QBihy8R0t, and Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vTQvfYu2llKQedmY as 3rd-rank arcane innate spells. You can cast each spell once per day.

name: Unknowing Polyglot
text: You have a deep and innate understanding of the foundations of communication as a whole. You learn an additional language. You get a +2 status bonus to Decipher Writing and can make such attempts even if you're untrained.

name: Unleash Hell!
text:
Frequency once per day

Requirements wearing armor customized with Hellknight regalia.
Your armor unleashes a gout of hellfire in a , dealing |options:area-damage] damage per level of a type determined by your chosen Hellknight order (); a creature takes spirit damage instead if that would be more detrimental (as determined by the GM).

name: Unleash Pneuma
text:
You unleash a portion of your spiritual essence—either the vitality of your living body or the void of your undead soul—in a violent burst around you. You deal ] damage of your selected type (see below) to all adjacent creatures (basic Reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher). At 11th level and every 2 levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1d6.

When you take this feat, choose either vitality or void. Once chosen, this selection can't be changed. Unleash Pneuma deals the chosen damage type and gains the chosen trait.
Special You can take this feat twice, but you must select a different damage type each time. If you do, Unleash Pneuma's frequency becomes once per day per damage type, rather than once per day.

name: Unleash Sota's Flame
text: Channeling the heat of Sota's rekindled sun, you unleash a blast of plasma across the battlefield. You deal ] damage in a . For 1 minute afterward, your body is awash with solar energy. Creatures that Grab you or that hit you with an unarmed Strike or a non-reach melee weapon take ] damage. Creatures in the area must attempt a reflex save using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Critical Success The creature is unaffected. Success The creature takes half damage. Failure The creature takes full damage, plus ] damage, and is Dazzled for 1 round. Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, plus ] damage, and is Blinded for 1 round. For 1 minute afterward, your body is awash with solar energy. Creatures that Grab you or that hit you with an unarmed Strike or a non-reach melee weapon take ] damage.

name: Unleashed Anger
text: You unleash your contained anger at a situation. Your size increases to Large, and you're Clumsy 1. You gain a +1 status bonus to melee damage. This doesn't change your Speed, reach, or other statistics except as noted here. Your worn equipment automatically resizes to suit your new form, though it immediately returns to its original size if it leaves your possession. These effects last for 1 round. You can Sustain for up to 10 minutes, though you must then spend at least 10 minutes in your natural form before using Unleashed Anger again. Special If you're a red-blooded madrosarai, you can use Controlled Rage as a free action right after using Unleashed Anger. If you do, you gain a +2 status bonus to melee damage.

name: Unliving Memories
text: Some element of your borai nature gives you flashes from the beyond: visions from the afterlife you were intended for or might still one day obtain. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Religion. If you're already trained in Religion, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Additional Lore feat for a Lore subcategory about a specific plane tied to your afterlife (such as Heaven, Hell, Nirvana, or Outer Rifts Lore).

name: Unlucky for Some
text: Trigger You critically fail a saving throw or an enemy's Strike against you is a critical hit. Requirements You don't have the reaction. You gain the Lucky Break reaction for 24 hours and become immune to Unlucky for Some for 24 hours.

name: Unmistakable Lore
text: You never get information about your areas of expertise wrong. When you Recall Knowledge using any Lore subcategory in which you're trained, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead. If you're a master in a Lore subcategory, on a critical success, you gain even more information or context than usual.

name: Unquenchable Breath
text: When you use Dragonkin Breath, a creature who fails or critically fails its saving throw takes 2d6[persistent,@actor.flags.pf2e.dragonkinBreath.damageType] damage of the same type. On a critical failure, the flat check to remove persistent damage increases to DC 20 (or DC 15, if the flat check would be reduced because the creature has an appropriate type of help). If you apply a critical weapon specialization effect that also deals persistent damage of the same type, apply this persistent damage in addition to the base persistent damage.

name: Unrelenting Joy
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Requirements You're Frightened or taking persistent mental damage. Your outlook on life is full of boundless hope. Reduce your frightened condition by 1. If you're taking persistent mental damage, roll a flat to see if you recover from that persistent mental damage. Special The frequency of Unrelenting Joy is once per minute as long as your soulfeel is attuned to joy.

name: Unseen Tides
text: The surge of Kalo-Mahoi's ever-present tides courses in your blood, and you can feel their pull wherever you go. You gain Unfettered Movement as a 4th-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.

name: Unsettling Display
text: You can Demoralize those around you by shifting your muscular and skeletal systems around. When you do, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language.

name: Unstable Flare
text: You supercharge your solar flare and unleash multiple simultaneous blasts at all foes in an area. Make a solar flare Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty against each enemy in a type:burst|distance:15 centered on any point within your solar flare's first range increment. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your penalty until you've made all your attacks. Graviton-Attuned You can Stride up to half your speed once as a free action immediately before or after making your attacks. Photon-Attuned You're Concealed to each target of this attack until the start of your next turn.

name: Unstable Flare
text:
You supercharge your solar flare and unleash multiple simultaneous blasts at all foes in an area. Make a solar flare Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty against each enemy in a centered on any point within your solar flare's first range increment. Each attack counts toward your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your penalty until you've made all your attacks.

Graviton-Attuned You can Stride up to half your speed once as a free action immediately before or after making your attacks.

Photon-Attuned You're to each target of this attack until the start of your next turn.

name: Unstable Overdrive
text: Frequency once per day You push your circuitry to its physical limits, maximizing your physical and mental capabilities. You become Quickened and Glitching 1 for 1 minute. You can use your extra action only to Stride or Strike. While quickened in this way, you gain a +2 status bonus to your AC, attack rolls, and saving throws. You can't reduce your glitching value until you lose the quickened condition.

name: Unstoppable Directives
text: Your confidence is a battery that keeps your allies going. When you use a directive that grants temporary Hit Points, increase the temporary Hit Points by your level. When you use a directive that doesn't grant temporary Hit Points, you can grant one ally affected by that directive temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Unstoppable Directives
text: Your confidence is a battery that keeps your allies going. When you use a directive that grants temporary Hit Points, increase the temporary Hit Points by your level. When you use a directive that doesn't grant temporary Hit Points, you can grant one ally affected by that directive temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Unstoppable Inertia
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger You would become Fatigued, Immobilized, Paralyzed, slowed, or Suppressed. You refuse to stop moving, pushing yourself beyond effects that would stop most creatures. You delay the effects of the triggering condition until the end of your next turn. Each time you use a move action while the condition is being delayed, you continue to delay the condition an additional round, up to 6 rounds. If the condition has a duration, the duration begins to elapse only after the delay. You can't further delay or prevent the condition after this ability ends.

name: Untrained Improvisation
text: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. Your proficiency bonus to untrained skill checks is equal to your level –2. This improves to your level –1 at 5th level and your full level at 7th level. This doesn't allow you to use the skill's trained actions.

name: Unusual Treatment
text: Your medical training extends to less obvious conditions. When you succeed against a DC 20 check to Treat Wounds, you can also reduce the value of one Clumsy, Enfeebled, or Stupefied condition on the patient by 1. If you're able to treat more than one creature at once, choose only one to gain this benefit. A creature can benefit from Unusual Treatment only once per day. If the condition results from an affliction, the affliction isn't cured, though the condition is reduced as long as the affliction remains at that stage. If you are a master in Medicine, add the Drained condition to the list of conditions you can remove if you succeed at a DC 30 check. If you are legendary in Medicine, you reduce the chosen condition by 2 instead of by 1.

name: Upgrade Slot Expansion
text: Your chassis has been modified with an extra augmentation slot. You can install one additional personal upgrade of your choice.

name: Upright Rest
text: You sleep in quadrupedal posture with the rest of your body mostly upright, allowing you to easily sleep in armor. You can sleep in armor overnight without being Fatigued the next day. If you were already fatigued before sleeping, the armor doesn't prevent you from recovering from being fatigued.

name: Urban Roots
text: You were either created in a densely populated area such as a city or have spent significant time in one. As a result, you've learned to apply your intuition and knowledge from the wilderness to the streets of metropolises and the narrow corridors of massive starships alike. You become trained in Survival (or another skill if you're already trained in Survival), and you gain the Urban Survivalist skill feat.

name: Urban Survivalist
text: You thrive in city environments as naturally as others do in the wilderness. You can use Survival to Subsist in urban areas, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks in any settlement.

name: Urchin
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes Trigger A creature Grabs you or successfully Strikes you with an unarmed melee strike or a non-reach melee weapon. You flex the spines running down the back of your head and neck as a defensive response. The attacking creature takes (floor((@actor.level + 1) / 3 + 1))d6[piercing] damage, with a reflex|against:class-spell|basic save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a critical failure, the target also takes (floor((@actor.level + 1) / 3 + 1))[persistent,bleed] damage. At 8th level and every 3 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d6, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

name: Use the Scenery
text: Performing for an audience has made you aware of your surroundings. You're always looking for ways to use the scenery to your advantage, setting yourself up to show your best angle to the world—or hide it! You always gain an additional +1 status bonus when you Take Cover.

name: Used To It
text: Trigger You're struck by a critical hit that deals energy damage or critically fail a saving throw against an effect that deals energy damage. You're used to taking serious amounts of damage from all kinds of extreme Rodnarth weather, from acid quakes to lightning waves. Attempt a flat. On a success, the triggering attack becomes a normal hit, or you fail the saving throw against the triggering effect instead of critically failing.

name: Vapor Form
text: Frequency once per hour You can transform your body into a gaseous vapor. In this state, you're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency rank in unarmored defense. You gain resistance 8 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You gain a fly Speed equal to your normal fly Speed and can slip through tiny cracks. This form lasts for 5 minutes or until you Dismiss it.

name: Vast Intellect
text: Your crystalline matrices store immense knowledge. You become trained in three additional Lore skills of your choice.

name: Vault Guard
text: Your training under the elite mercenaries in the Vault were brutal for your body and your mind, but they've hardened your constitution and left you with rare expertise. You've done plenty of drills wearing the heaviest equipment, and you're quick to adapt to even the most specialized protective gear. You're trained in heavy armor. Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in medium armor, you also gain that proficiency in heavy armor.

name: Vector Reflector
text: Trigger A Suppressed creature damages you with a Strike. Your armor absorbs some of the kinetic energy of your opponent's attack. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the triggering damage (or equal to your level if you have the Armor Storm fighting style). If the triggering creature is within reach, attempt an Athletics check to Shove it.

name: Vector Reflector
text:
Trigger A creature damages you with a Strike.

Your armor absorbs some of the kinetic energy of your opponent's attack. You gain resistance equal to half your level against the triggering damage (or equal to your level if you have the fighting style). If the triggering creature is within reach, attempt an Athletics check to it.

name: Veil of Ink
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes You vent most of your ink all at once, filling a small area with obscuring droplets. You create a stationary cloud of ink in a centered on your current location. Creatures are Concealed while inside the cloud, and creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures inside the cloud. The ink dissipates at the start of your next turn. This ability functions equally effectively above or below water.

name: Vengeful Gore
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger An adjacent enemy deals damage to you with an unarmed melee Strike. With an angry bellow, you lean into your horns to gore the offending opponent. Make a horns Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a success, the creature takes an additional 2d6 bleed damage.

name: Venomous Cocktail
text: You can enhance your natural venom by imbibing more poison, allowing it to mix with your natural poison production. You Interact to draw (if necessary) and chug a dose of poison or one piece of projectile ammunition from a weapon you're holding that deals poison damage. Add ] damage to the next Strike you make with your venomous jaws. The damage increases to two dice if your held weapon is advanced grade or superior grade, three dice if the weapon is elite grade or ultimate grade, and four dice if the weapon is paragon grade. On a critical hit, roll these dice after doubling the weapon's damage.

name: Vent Crawler
text: You're a sneaky stowaway who knows that vents are the best way to get around aboard a ship or station. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the skill feat.

name: Vent Gas
text: Frequency once per hour You vent gas to propel yourself forward. All squares in a type:emanation|distance:5 become filled with gas. All creatures in the gas become Concealed, and all creatures outside the gas become concealed to creatures within it. This gas disperses at the beginning of your next turn. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to all your Speeds until the start of your next turn. Then you Stride.

name: Verdant Psychic
text: Your psychic abilities manifest in a supernatural connection to the natural world, particularly the jungles on Castrovel and on planets with similar environments. You gain the Tangle Vine and Scan Environment cantrips as primal innate spells at will. These cantrips are heightened to half your level.

name: Verdant Sense
text: You can sense changes to flora and fauna within the range of your limited telepathy. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find living environmental hazards. Even if you aren't Searching, you can attempt to find living environmental hazards that normally require you to be Searching.

name: Versatile Outfit
text: You are known for your astounding custom outfits and pride yourself on designing versatile and reconfigurable garments, allowing you to create nearly any look in a matter of moments. You can use the Crafting skill rather than Deception to Impersonate another person, and can do so in 1 minute rather than the usual 10 minutes. You don't need a disguise kit to Impersonate a specific person when using Crafting to do so, and a maker's toolkit grants a +1 item bonus to the check.

name: Very Sneaky
text: You're stealthier than your size suggests. You can move 5 feet farther when you Sneak, and you remain undetected even if your cover or concealment ends mid-movement.

name: Vesk Weapon Familiarity
text: You are trained in vesk weapons (battlegloves, carbon steel curve blades). You gain access to vesk weapon critical specialization effects.

name: Veskarium Logistics Specialist
text: The Veskarium has a proud tradition of training disciplined quartermasters whose contributions to the empire's success through logistical acumen rival those of the greatest vesk warriors. You gain the Prescient Consumable and Prescient Planner feats.

name: Vestigial Restraint
text: Countless generations of specialization have stripped your two pairs of vestigial arms of much of their strength, but you've trained them to gain enough strength to be useful in combat. Though they aren't strong or agile enough to grab an opponent, you can use them to maintain a grip you already have. When you successfully grapple a creature that's at least one size smaller than you, you can transfer the foe to your vestigial arms as a free action, freeing your primary hands. You have a –2 circumstance penalty to the Escape DC for your grapple against creatures you have Grabbed in your vestigial arms.

name: Veteran Trap Finder
text: You can use {Mission Lore} instead of Computers or Thievery to disable traps in locations you researched using Mission Briefing. You can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of master in Computers or Thievery. If you have master proficiency in Computers or Thievery, you can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of legendary in that skill instead, and increase the circumstance bonus you gain from Danger Awareness to +2.

name: Veteran Traveler
text: You've spent years traveling, and you know better than most that roads aren't always paved. Or clear. Or even built yet. You become trained in Nature or Survival. If you're already trained in both of those skills, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Choose one kind of terrain from the following list: muddy, rocky, sandy, sloped, or undergrowth. You ignore difficult or uneven terrain of that type.

name: Vibe Eruption
text: By allowing yourself to drown in ambient emotions, you can cause them to spill over and erupt around you in a cathartic flow of primal energy. You can cast Vibe Check as a 4th-rank primal innate spell four times per day. You must select a different emotion each time you Cast the Spell in a day, and the emotion must match your current soulfeel (or wonder, if you select fear).

name: Vibration Whiskers
text: Your whiskers have developed the same senses as that of your bonded hymothoa. You gain motion sense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. Motion sense allows you to detect nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

name: Vicious Breath
text: The intensity of your draconic breath lays waste to the environment and your foes. When you use Dragonkin Breath, the area of your breath becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Any creature that enters the area of your dragonkin breath or is occupying your breath's area at the end of its turn takes 4d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.dragonkinBreath.damageType] damage of the same type (reflex|against:class-spell|basic save against the same DC as your dragonkin breath).

name: Vicious Takedown
text: Requirements Your most recent action was a success on a melee Strike against a creature who is at least one size larger than you. You know that being small only means you need to be more vicious to survive and have learned to use your size to your advantage against larger foes. Attempt an Athletics check to Shove or Trip the target, ignoring the size requirements. If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Vigilant Administrator
text: You gain an extra reaction each round that can only be used to Counterspell.

name: Virtuosic Performer
text: You've mastered a particular performance style. Choose one type of performance (acting, dancing, oratory, singing, etc.); you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Performance checks of that type.

name: Visceral Warmask
text: Requirements You're adjacent to a creature that isn't immune to bleed damage and died within the last minute. You dip your fingers into the gushing wounds of the fallen, using their ichor to mask your face in a visceral ritual that pays homage to the fallen while calming yourself for in the din of battle. For 1 minute, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]], a +1 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects, and at the end of your turn, reduce your condition by 2 instead of 1.

name: Visual Static
text: You scrub your presence from your enemies' minds in a blast of psychic static that disorients them. You become Concealed against any number of observable creatures of your choice within 30 feet for 1 round.

name: Vital Sap
text: The sticky sap produced by your vined body has healing properties. You produce 1d4 vials of sap each day when you are exposed to natural sunlight for at least 4 hours. A creature that drinks a vial of the sap as an Interact action restores 2d8 Hit Points. This effect has the healing and vitality traits.

name: Vitality Network
text: You gain a Vitality Network with 10 Hit Points and can use Transfer Vitality to transfer up to 10 HP. Increase the maximum capacity of your vitality network by 10 at 10th, 15th, and 20th-level. Increase the amount you can transfer by 5 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th-level.

name: Vitality Web
text: You can manifest your bond as a web of vital energy between your allies. You learn the Vitality Web epiphany spell.

name: Vitality Web
text: You can manifest your bond as a web of vital energy between your allies. You learn the epiphany spell.

name: Vlaka Lore
text: You strive to keep the traditions and stories of your people alive, even as you build new communities and forge new alliances. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Diplomacy and Society. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Additional Lore general feat for Vlaka Lore.

name: Void Blood
text: The ichor pulsing through your veins is infused with void energy, and it protects your body and soul from the same sinister power. You have void resistance equal to half your level.

name: Void Flier
text: You're at home in zero gravity. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics in zero-g and can fly at full Speed without checks in such environments.

name: Void Inversion
text: You've learned to channel your void inversion into another creature. You gain Void Seed as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once every 10 minutes.
